meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让关键计划在敲定前先经受多方挑刺与交叉质疑,变得更扎实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你制定关键计划时希望有人从对立角度帮你查漏补缺,而不是只收获附和。
copy.tagline_en: Toughen up your plan by running it past a hostile review team before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own important plans and want them to survive hostile scrutiny before being locked in.

howto.what: Claude 会召集 5 名立场互斥的评审角色，让它们对计划相互攻击、交叉批判，只保留扛住攻击的观点，再交给独立规划器形成正式计划。
howto.when: 当用户要求做 hyperplan、对抗式/交叉批判式规划，或需要最大严谨度的规划时触发。

say.text: 请对我的项目计划启动 hyperplan 对抗评审。
say.note: 5 个角色会交叉攻击你的计划。

say.text: 用对抗式规划把这份迁移方案过一遍。
say.note: 筛选经受住攻击的部分再形成计划。

say.text: 启动 hyperplan，对这个新功能计划做交叉批判。
say.note: 最终由独立规划器产出正式计划。

howto.what_en: Claude leads a 5-member hostile team whose members attack each other's critiques. Only insights that survive are kept, then a dedicated planner formalizes them into a work plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for a hyperplan, an adversarial or cross-critique plan, or when maximum-rigor planning is requested.

say_en.text: Run a hyperplan adversarial review on my project plan.
Take this migration proposal through adversarial planning.
Start hyperplan and cross-critique this feature plan.
